name: Sugawara Miki
source: Head of the Science Club. Had a revelation that the world revolves around Mahjong and was born from a Mahjong tile, tried to convince her peers at the university but got expelled. Mostly plays Mahjong as a way to learn the truth about reality, determined to prove her theory to the science world.
